name: STORMFRAME
summary:
Step into the cockpit of a combat mech and face giant monsters in first-person VR. Move your arms to block and strike back, then bring ranged firepower into the fight.

**Fight up close**

Raise your arms to block, punch back when you see an opening, or swing a melee weapon. Grab and throw objects during close combat.
